facts.fact: According to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt, US advertisers were projected to spend $62.96 billion on programmatic video in 2022, up from $52.17 billion in 2021.
facts.quote: in 2022 US advertisers will spend $62.96 billion on this programmatic channel, up from $52.17 billion in 2021.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt, US advertisers' programmatic video spend in 2021 was $52.17 billion.
According to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt, US programmatic video ad spend was expected to climb to $74.88 billion in 2023.
facts.quote: And that spend is expected to climb to $74.88 billion in 2023.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that programmatic video ad spend growth has been more than 20% year over year.
facts.quote: More than 20% year-over-year growth signals that marketers are increasingly recognizing and investing in the value of video.

facts.fact: According to Hubspot research cited by StackAdapt, the amount of online video watched has almost doubled since 2018.
